To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. NFSU Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NFSU Research Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 28-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFSU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFSU Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant position at NFSU is 28th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference is given to those with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification indicates that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role at NFSU?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the National Forensic Sciences University located?
faq.answer: The National Forensic Sciences University is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 382007.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. When is the interview scheduled for the shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 02nd September 2026.
